title: Algorithm with variable coefficients for computing matrix inverses
summary: We present a general scheme for the construction of new eficient generalized Schultz iterative methods for computing the inverse matrix. These methods have the form $$ X_{k+1} = X_k(a_0^{(k)}I+a_1^{(k)}AX_k),\quad k\in\mathbb{N}, $$ where $A$ is square real matrix and $a_0^{(k)}$ and $a_0^{(k)}$ are dynamical coefficients. We are going to present basic case of the problem, while formulas are derived analogically in other cases but are more complicated.
